seo.description: Boost your English listening skills with this B1 intermediate comprehension test on School and Education. Feedback & transcript are included!

parts:
B1 English Listening Test

Listen to four people share their personal school experiences, and for questions 1 to 7, choose the correct answer.

See the full list of B1 listening tests
Questions

choices.html: To describe how hard he has to work.
Because he is proud of his last essay.
To state that he needs to stop.
Because it's his last semester.
Because he wants to study in a foreign country.
Because he needs a good mark in German.

questions.prompt: Why did Jessica have to drop a class last term?

choices.html: Because she wanted more flexibility in her schedule.
Because balancing both work and school was too much.
Because the assignments were too hard.

questions.prompt: What does Jessica say she's learning from studying online?

choices.html: How to use digital tools.
How to be more productive.
How to work with people.

questions.prompt: Why did Liam have to retake some exams?

choices.html: Because he didn't take them when he was at school.
Because they weren't easy.
Because his marks weren't good enough.

questions.prompt: What would Liam like to do after his graduation?

choices.html: Pursue advanced studies in engineering.
Start a business.
Work in a different field.

questions.prompt: Why didn't Daniel get good grades in high school?

choices.html: He had trouble adapting to all the changes.
He was hanging out with the wrong people.
He didn't understand the importance of studying.
